title: Six-Seven Bags
statement: Among n ≤ 10^5 bags of a_i coins, one contains 6-gram coins and must be found in the optimal number of weighings against an adaptive interactor. A weighing reveals how many coins came from the hidden bag, so each bag needs a distinct code vector in [0,a_i]^q; by pigeonhole, f(a) is the least q with #{a_i ≤ c} ≤ (c+1)^q, met non-adaptively by assigning codes greedily in sorted order.
